Ребята, не ссорьтесь!
У меня есть ещё один миска риса!

I do enjoy how lively this place becomes in the morning. The noise makes everything feel so full of life! Though, mm~ most of that bustle does seem to come from furniture shattering и people being thrown about. Still... Если you admire them from a distance, the sounds blur together в a certain rustic charm.

Mm~ So this is the must-try dish my colleague kept raving about. Can't wait to see whether it can live до such a glowing recommendation as "Если you still haven't tried it на the time I ask you again, we're going to have to settle this with a duel!"
The Virescent Pyrojade is useful for much больше чем simply melting things, you know. Here, come closer. It'll warm you right up in this brisk air after sundown.

Hmm... I suppose so? But it's a bit of a chicken-и-egg problem, isn't it? Do people choose these parts for brawls because our branch is nearby, или did we build the branch here because we saw the business opportunity ripe for the picking? Whichever is the case, believe me, scarcely a day passes here without a fight breaking out при one of the nearby kezhans.
Not that we mind, of course~ It only means more commissions for us.

Excuse me, I noticed you were actively avoiding eye contact with me, и I was wondering если—Oh, I remember now! You were my opponent in that last duel! How are your wounds?
You don't have to avoid me—that was just work, you know? No hard feelings при все. Ah, would you like some hot xiaolongbao to warm you up? My treat! Thanks to you, I've made quite a bit of coin. It's the least I can do!

There's a certain elegance to duels as a concept, don't you think? It is, in essence, a simple, no-holds-barred contest of martial arts meant to hurt each other... But we start it off with a polite bow, shake hands один раз we're done, и everything goes back to the way they used to be with no lingering ill will.
What about Уровень 3 Duels, you ask? Well, those don't get called все that often anyway.

Please choose whichever weapon you prefer! I recommend going with something you're most familiar with. Ah, don't worry если you don't see your weapon of choice—just let us know what it is, и our Association will have one brought over in no time.
Just be aware that requesting a weapon you think is impossible to procure is not a way out of the duel. Whichever type of weapon you choose, we'll be sure to get it for you.

Fuhu, there's no need to get so heated about losing a Уровень 2 Duel. Nowhere in its rules does it say that it has to be a fight to the death, does it? So why not just yield и make this easy for the both of us, и...
... <size=75%>By the way, there's nothing stopping you from electing me as your revenge duel proxy right away—how's that for a plan? I'll even throw in a 50% discount on the contract fee, hehe.</size>
Whoa, you do know that tossing that thing при me means a declaration of duel, don't you? Ahaha, just kidding.
Okay. Now, the Cinq will be taking over this duel. Hm... Why don't you yield? You might want to decide soon, because you're this close to catching fire, from the collar up.
Why, of course. You can count on me~
Cinq Association East Section 3—Hong Lu.
Oh, sorry. We're prohibited from overbooking commissions~
I do hope you'll teach me a thing или two in this bout.
How about it? I think it's better you yield now...
Aha~
Oh... и after I went to the trouble of warning you.
"A true master seldom makes their arrival known," they say... How very true... that is...
There we are. It's open~
Oh dear... I might've accidentally welded it shut...

Next time, please go through the official commissioning process если you wanna hire me as your proxy duelist. I prefer having a chance to look в my prospective opponents before a fight, you see...
I didn't know how much restraint was needed today, и the opponents все perished before I could even persuade them to yield...

Done и done, resolved exactly as you requested! Here's your bill... Huh? You don't seem pleased... Is something the matter?
Let's see... Rush fee, active duel intervention fee, off-duty commission fee... Yes, every surcharge has been billed appropriately, при a reasonable cap, too. There's nothing extra!

I'm sorry. I hadn't imagined the request could fail... Yes, of course. I'll cover the failure compensation in full. It's just that... I simply can't understand what a person of such skill is doing in a place like this... Oh, I... never mind what I said!
